items.title: Kaizen Software
items.description: Software development company co-founded with partners. Custom development for clients in retail, education and commerce: from requirements gathering to production deployment and support. Delivered 12+ web and mobile projects, built transactional platforms with payment gateways, real-time notifications and automated web scraping queries.

items.title: Independent
items.description: Computer vision and industrial IoT systems for production plants. Designed and deployed edge-to-cloud solutions for quality control and industrial safety, integrating software with plant hardware: RTSP/USB cameras, inference on Raspberry Pi 5, PLCs via OPC UA and SCADA systems.

items.title: ADS Software
items.description: My experience focused on the design and development of Dynamic Link Libraries (DLLs) to facilitate the migration of legacy systems based on Visual FoxPro to the modern Firebase platform.

items.title: UNHCR (ACNUR)
items.description: Participated in a Social Project for Technical Assistance for Strengthening Enterprises of Refugees in collaboration with UNHCR-HIAS-ESPE. Performed monitoring, maintenance, and development of the Prowessec website.
